product_title: Handcrafted Ganesha Lotus Pearl Toran (38 inches)
product_description: Bring divine elegance and festive charm to your home with this beautifully handcrafted traditional toran. Featuring a central Lord Ganesha motif, decorative golden elephants, vibrant pink lotus designs, colourful circular embellishments, intricate golden detailing, and delicate pearl hangings, this toran adds a graceful traditional touch to your entrance. Perfect for decorating main doors, pooja rooms, mandir entrances, and living spaces during Diwali, Ganesh Chaturthi, weddings, housewarming ceremonies, and other auspicious occasions. Its rich colours and detailed craftsmanship make it a beautiful addition to your festive home decor.
product_care_suggestion: Gently dust with a soft, dry cloth or a soft-bristled brush.
Avoid water, excessive moisture, and harsh cleaning chemicals.
Handle the pearl tassels and decorative embellishments carefully to prevent damage.
Keep away from prolonged direct sunlight to preserve the vibrant colors and golden finish.
Store in a dry place in a protective box or fabric bag when not in use.
